compatibility_rule: EKRI product versions are fully compatible only when they share the same current Project Knowledge asset-layout generation. A layout-generation change starts a new compatibility generation. Backward readability of older asset schemas may be retained but does not make two generations fully compatible.
notes: Compatibility is about the persisted Project Knowledge asset structure, not about whether every CLI or Skill surface is identical.
A newer generation may retain explicit backward readers for older asset schemas; this is migration/backward support, not full generation compatibility.
Whenever the current Project Knowledge asset schema/layout changes incompatibly, add a new generation before release.
